IN NO EVENT SHALL THE AUTHORS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES, OR OTHER LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM, OUT OF, OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE, OR IN THE USE OF OR OTHER DEALINGS OF THE SOFTWARE. ``` The difference is - apart from authors or copyright holders in MIT-0 - lies only in punctuation and a change of the last sentence: I'd argue this it a MIT-0 variant. Or otherwise the license does not meet the inclusion principles, because this license is rarely used.
